scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run dev -w @jingjian/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run build -w @jingjian/pipeline && npm run build -w @jingjian/web
scripts.pipeline: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run pipeline -w @jingjian/pipeline
scripts.generate: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run generate -w @jingjian/pipeline
scripts.hydrate: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run hydrate -w @jingjian/pipeline
scripts.check: npm run build -w @jingjian/domain && npm run check -w @jingjian/pipeline
